Intel (INTC) vs Advanced Micro Devices (AMD): on the same formula, their operating margins are 14.9 pts apart. What does that gap explain, and what doesn’t it?

Latest fiscal year, same formula
• Revenue — INTC: $52.9B · AMD: $34.6B
• Revenue growth — INTC: −0.5% · AMD: +34.3%
• Operating margin — INTC: −4.2% · AMD: 10.7%
• Net margin — INTC: −0.5% · AMD: 12.5%
• Free cash flow margin — INTC: −9.4% · AMD: 19.4%
• 4-year revenue growth (compound annual) — INTC: −9.6% · AMD: 20.5%
